note: The quokkas the wallpaper maker offers, rendered from rotli's REAL <Character> (src/components/character.tsx) by scripts/render-companions.ts --spec motion/brand/wallpaper-looks.json. Pose, style and accessory ids are the app's own; the labels are the maker's. Every emotion × colour × accessory is rendered, and the colours listed in darkVariants are rendered again under the dark theme (the line style draws white ink there). Tintable: filled accessories are rendered white and tint-<pose>-<accessory> holds where their colour goes, so the maker multiplies in any accessory hue with the app's own oklch(70% 0.15 hue). Separate from companions.json on purpose: those 22 looks back sealed pieces' goldens.
